programme.title: Khuda Haafiz: Chapter 2
programme.desc: After the death of his friend's brother, Sameer and Nargis adopt his daughter Nandini. However, trouble ensues when she gets kidnapped.

programme.title: Daddy
programme.desc: Arun Gawli rises from poverty and becomes one of India's most notable gangsters. However, hungry for more power and influence, he launches a career in politics.

programme.title: The Power
programme.desc: Though two lovers' families are ripped apart for the sake of revenge and power, they rise out of that pit of bloodlust and despair together.

programme.title: Yaara
programme.desc: Phagun and Mitwa are life-long friends who join the same gang and become smugglers. But their loyalty to each other is tested when one of them gets arrested.

programme.title: Sniff
programme.desc: Sunny, who lacks the sense of smell, finds his olfactory abilities enhanced after becoming a victim of a laboratory accident, which turns him into a superhero.

programme.title: Daas Dev
programme.desc: Dev is the heir to the throne who is challenged by his beloved Paro in his political backyard. Chandni loves Dev, although she knows that her love is unrequited.

programme.title: Happy Phirr Bhag Jayegi
programme.desc: Harpreet Kaur, a woman who travels to China to find her fiancé, gets mistakenly kidnapped by gangsters whose assignment was to abduct another woman of the same name travelling by the same flight.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: A desperate Shaurya moves into an empty high-rise building where he and his lover can stay. However, things take a dark turn when he finds himself locked in his new apartment without any amenities.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Following her political rise, Indira Gandhi navigates national crises, war and a controversial state of emergency. Her eventual comeback leads to personal losses and rising political unrest.

programme.title: Madgaon Express
programme.desc: Childhood friends Dodo, Ayush and Pinku embark on a trip to Goa that goes completely off-track due to a sequence of terrible decisions.

programme.title: Gully Boy
programme.desc: The life of an underdog rapper from Dharavi who struggles to express his views on social issues through rapping, changes completely after he bumps into Shrikant alias MC Sher.

programme.title: Zubeidaa
programme.desc: Brought up by his maternal grandmother, Riyaz is on a determined quest to find and understand his mother. His search ultimately takes him on the complex journey his mother went through.

programme.title: Zubeidaa
programme.desc: Brought up by his maternal grandmother, Riyaz is on a determined quest to find and understand his mother. His search ultimately takes him on the complex journey his mother went through.

programme.title: Jayantabhai Ki Luv Story
programme.desc: A street thug and a young woman from different backgrounds fall in love with each other. They plan to get married, but her father disapproves.

programme.title: Kuch Kuch Locha Hai
programme.desc: Praveen Patel, a 45-year-old married businessman, is tired of his religious wife though he loves her. However, things change after a younger actress wants to move in with him to prepare for a role.

programme.title: Turtle
programme.desc: Ramkaran tirelessly churns the dry earth of a village in Rajasthan for water. Meanwhile, the villagers participate in desperate measures to satisfy their thirst.

programme.title: Chakravyuh
programme.desc: Kabir infiltrates a Maoist organisation to help Adil Khan, who is a decorated police officer and his friend. As he gets deeper into the organisation, Kabir starts sympathising with the group's plight and starts having second thoughts.

programme.title: InCar
programme.desc: A ruthless gang abducts an innocent young maiden from a bus stop on a national highway in Haryana. Furthermore, the defenceless girl fights for her survival and escape.

programme.title: Kucch Luv Jaisaa
programme.desc: After getting bored with her loveless marriage, a wife decides to get a breath of fresh air and meets a hitman, who she thinks is a private detective.

programme.title: Rashtra Kavach Om
programme.desc: A classified mission leaves a para commando with amnesia, unanswered questions and the duty of protecting his nation from terrorists. Along the way, he must find his father and prove his innocence.

programme.title: Forensic
programme.desc: When a psychotic murderer sets out on a killing spree, Samuel, a medico-legal advisor, uses his forensic skills to unravel the truth behind the heinous deeds.

programme.title: Dhaakad
programme.desc: Despite her reservations, Agent Agni takes up the mission to track and capture Rudraveer, a trafficker in India. However, the assignment soon takes her down unnavigated routes.

programme.title: Deva
programme.desc: A police officer investigates the murder of his close friend. However, he suffers a traumatic accident that wipes away his memory, jeopardising the investigation.

programme.title: Dono
programme.desc: Dev, a start-up owner, travels to Thailand in order to attend the wedding of Alina, his childhood crush. While he struggles to deal with his feelings for Alina, he falls for another girl.

programme.title: Blank
programme.desc: A suicide bomber named Hanif loses his memory before he could complete his mission. Resultantly, the Anti-Terrorism Squad must find out his real plan and save the country from a deadly attack.

programme.title: Rang Rasiya
programme.desc: A young and talented Raja Ravi Varma trains under the king of Kerala. He moves to Bombay and meets Sugandha, who initially discredits his artwork but later becomes his muse.

programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Mera Spondylitis Phoot Gaya!
programme.desc: An unfortunate accident leads to Riya and Varun realizing the small ways in which their relationship has changed since they were together.

programme.title: Bhen-dad!
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Riya's dad sends Riya, Varun, and Devika in disarray as they have to scramble to make sure he doesn't find out Riya and Varun are not a couple anymore.

programme.title: Mamla Gehra Hai
programme.desc: Riya and Varun are forced to make tough decisions about their future together in the house. To add to their woes, a burglary at the house leaves them deprived of a special possession.

programme.title: Humanize the Ex
programme.desc: To celebrate their stay at the house, the exes - Riya and Varun - decide to have a bonfire party on their lawn. There, they reminisce about their relationship so far.

programme.title: Naye Armaan
programme.desc: Varun turns 30, and Ria is introduced to Anisha. Back in the day, Varun and Ria finally move into a house together.

programme.title: Humesha
programme.desc: Ria decides to go home and tell her parents the truth about Varun and Ria's breakup. Back in the day, Varun and Ria's parents come over as the families meet and make plans for their future.

programme.title: Khwaab
programme.desc: Ria finally admits to having feelings for Varun. Back in the day, we see trouble in Varun and Ria's relationship for the first time.

programme.title: Tanha
programme.desc: Ria starts to look for new houses. Back in the day, Ria and Varun are still dealing with their broken trust, and everything changes.

programme.title: Darmaan
programme.desc: Varun and Ria break up.

programme.title: Hum
programme.desc: Varun and Ria try and make their relationship work.

programme.title: Feels Like Responsibility
programme.desc: As Avi and Lakshay prepare for their "first second house party", Avi's dad decides to drop in for a surprise visit. Meanwhile, Sameer tries to think of different ways to get his unwanted roommate Gandhi to shift to the living room instead. Will their first second party go as planned?

programme.title: Feels Like Give and Take
programme.desc: After weeks of witnessing the boys make a mess of Bancchod Niwas, Sameer tells them to clean up their act. Lakshay's solution is? Get a housekeeper. Meanwhile, Avi, still reeling from his breakup with Mahima, decides to make a "grand gesture", which also inspires Lakshay to get another quirky roommate.

programme.title: Feels Like Summer
programme.desc: As the Delhi heat rises in full force, tempers rise with it. Sameer tries to push himself to perform his poetry for an audience that isn't Lloyd, while Avi tries to drown his sorrows by pretending like he's completely fine. Tensions implode and so do Gandhi's... special parts.

programme.title: Feels Like Finding Yourself
programme.desc: Avi has the greatest plan (his words) to move on and spend time with himself - an Imtiaz Ali-themed tour of Delhi. What could go wrong? Meanwhile, Gandhi's first day of cricket practice doesn't quite go as planned, and Lakshay meets an unexpected acquaintance.

programme.title: Feels Like Family
programme.desc: The boys are at Lakshay's family home for his sister's wedding. As Avi and Gandhi gear up to get lucky, Sameer has a significant revelation. Lakshay, meanwhile, feels out of the loop with his own family, as he feels replaced by his nemesis John. The wedding weekend rages with the promise of chaos and drama.

programme.title: Feels Like Choices
programme.desc: The exam results of last semester are out and Avi's is less than perfect. Afraid to let his dad find out in case he is called back home, Avi cooks up a drastic plan with the help of Sameer and Gandhi. Meanwhile, Lakshay hosts a Fresher's party, where he comes to point of no return. Will the boys make the right choices?

programme.title: Wrath of Man
programme.desc: Mysterious and wild-eyed, a new security guard for a cash truck surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.

programme.title: The Ambush
programme.desc: When three Emirati soldiers are ambushed in hostile territory, their commander leads a daring mission to rescue them.

programme.title: Feels Like Rock Bottom
programme.desc: A single-take episode right after the events of the party where Avi finds out about Lakshay and Mahima, a fight breaks out between the boys as they deal with their own fears and the problems they have with each other. Will this be the end of their friendship?

programme.title: Feels Like Acceptance
programme.desc: Tensions in the house are at an all-time high. In the middle of this, Vicky Paaji comes home unannounced and starts to stay with the boys. The boys must now team up to kick Vicky Paaji out.

programme.title: Feels Like Hope
programme.desc: As the college fest approaches, Avi and Lakshay are teamed up together which leads to worse consequences for the two of them. Gandhi goes on a journey to find a new passion by participating in the fest, and Sameer pushes himself to face his fear of performing at the fest.

programme.title: The Age of Innocence
programme.desc: Ruhi needs a new phone and a scholarship, but also wants Lucky’s attention. Kenny wants to stand up for his rights but desperately needs help for the same.

programme.title: The Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Ruhi has second thoughts about her choices. Ayesha needs a story at any cost. Aparna is looking for payback. Meanwhile, Aditya makes some progress with the investigation.

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Bhati and Gagan face off in a surprisingly close-fought election. Ruhi has a close shave in an outstation exam. Tarush suffers a setback.

programme.title: Brave New World
programme.desc: Ruhi gets a taste of the good life, briefly, before the shit hits the fan. Tarush takes matters into his own hands. Aparna needs to regain control of her show. Bijoy smells a rat.

programme.title: Vanity Fair
programme.desc: Bhati overcommits to a sponsor and faces a logistical nightmare. Tarush follows the breadcrumbs. Everyone crosses paths at the college festival. Well, almost.

programme.title: The Lord of the Flies
programme.desc: Ayesha looks for missing books. Bijoy starts putting things together. Lucky finds himself in trouble. But Nadeem has bigger fish to fry.

programme.title: The Return of the Native
programme.desc: Lucky comforts a guilt-ridden Ruhi. Aarti makes a shocking discovery. Ayesha takes a trip. Bhati faces unexpected resistance. Gagan opens Aparna’s eyes.

programme.desc: Pradeep Bhaiyya, an annoying cousin shows up and takes Akhil and Rinzing for a drunken night. Kay sees Aryan making out. Vasudha, frustrated with her subtly sexist boss, heads out to a new age experience and hooks up with a much younger flute player.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: The marriage vow "till death do us part" lives up to its promise for the couples featured in "Happily Never After." It's a wedding show and police drama rolled into one, as the best days in the lives of brides and grooms tragically turn when homicides crash the honeymoons. Each episode tells the true story -- narrated by actress Marlo Thomas -- of a newlywed's murder, interspersed with flashbacks to happier days for the couple. Dr. Wendy Walsh, who holds a Ph.D. in clinical psychology and is a co-host on the syndicated program "The Doctors," offers commentary on the behavioral twists and turns in each story.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.desc: Shaamu, who lives a carefree life, falls in love with a well-educated girl, Raadha. However, circumstances force the young couple to part ways.

programme.title: Imaandaar
programme.desc: Things turn awry when a businessman, unaware of the truth, allows his pampered daughter to get engaged to the son of his old rival.

programme.title: Waqt Hamara Hai
programme.desc: Friends Vikas and Sunil, along with their girlfriends, Ayesha and Mamta, unknowingly become a part of an awful terrorist plot to kill a minister.

programme.title: Bluff Master
programme.desc: Ashok, a fraudster, pretends to be rich and cheats several people. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with Seema.

programme.title: Sachaa Jhutha
programme.desc: After his lookalike, Ranjith, convinces Bhola to impersonate him for money, an innocent Bhola soon finds himself in trouble when the police chase after him for Ranjith's crimes.

programme.title: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
programme.desc: Prakash plans to extort money from his distrusting father-in-law. Rahul and Harry, who are in desperate need of cash, join hands with Prakash and help kidnap his wife as part of the plan.

programme.title: Amba
programme.desc: When Amba gets her son Rajendra arrested for sexually assaulting their servant's daughter, Rajendra's wife wreaks havoc in their lives as she vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Amir Garib
programme.desc: Mohanlal, a musician and a thief, robs rich people and distributes the money amongst the poor. However, things take a turn when he falls for Sunita, a wealthy man's daughter.

programme.title: Suhaag
programme.desc: Twins Amit and Kishan are separated at birth. However, when their paths cross in the future, together they work their way through and strive to overcome challenges.

programme.title: Soldier
programme.desc: After Major Vijay Malhotra's colleagues betray him, he is branded as a traitor and subsequently killed. But his son, Vicky, vows to take revenge on his father's murderers and prove his innocence.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: Rajveer, a police officer, is tasked with protecting a nine-year-old heir, Abbas. However, the job gets complicated when Nazir, a dangerous criminal, seeks to harm the child.

programme.title: Champion

programme.title: Gair Kaanooni
programme.desc: Police Inspector Kapil Khanna realises that his baby boy has been switched with a girl child by the hospital and files a lawsuit against the owner, Robert Decosta, while trying to find his missing son.

programme.title: Kaun Sachcha Kaun Jhootha
programme.desc: Karan Saxena, a police officer, arrests Sapna Mathur, a woman accused of killing his fellow constable. Things take a turn when Karan falls in love with her and helps her escape her death sentence.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Ghar Sansar
programme.desc: When Prakash's father dies, he is forced to shoulder the financial responsibilities of his large family. However, his troubles increase when his younger brother leaves him home to join a gang.

programme.title: Tridev
programme.desc: When an expelled police inspector, an outlaw and a commissioner's son are implicated by a dealer, they unite to seek revenge and prove they are not culprits.

programme.title: Satta
programme.desc: Anuradha relocates to Mumbai where she meets Vivek, an aspiring politician, and marries him. Things take a turn when he is arrested for murder, and she has to take his place in the upcoming elections.

programme.title: Surkhaab
programme.desc: Jeet, a former judo champion, decides to travel to Canada in search of employment. However, since she has no money, she seeks the help of a local man who ends up cheating her.

programme.title: Chot - Aaj Isko, Kal Tereko
programme.desc: Kishan, a dairy farmer, and Kabir, his brother, run into trouble when a local promoter decides to take over their land. When a corrupt inspector plays his part and kills Kabir, Kishan vows vengeance.

programme.title: Vishwatma
programme.desc: A policeman and a reformed criminal go to Kenya to comprehend a syndicate leader. However, they must break the rules of the land defended by Surya Pratap, a Kenyan police inspector.

programme.title: Udhaar Ki Zindagi
programme.desc: Sitaram refuses to accept his son Vasudev's marriage to Suman. Years later, he eagerly awaits their return from the USA but is left disheartened when his granddaughter Sita turns up alone.

programme.title: Avtaar

programme.title: Amrit
programme.desc: A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead.

programme.title: Nishant

programme.title: Battalion 609

programme.title: Animal Armoury
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. "Animal Armory" incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Descending
programme.desc: In this 13-part documentary series, hosts Scott Wilson and Ellis Emmett descend beneath the surface to explore the three-quarters of the planet that is covered in water. Each episode features a new location, where Wilson and Emmett discover all that the area has to offer. They explore the cultures of the local people, share stories of human triumph and tragedy, and connect the world on land to the one in the sea. With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.

programme.title: Curieux Bégin
programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. Christian Bégin nous entraîne dans de délicieuses aventures épicuriennes. Ses invités nous font découvrir plusieurs cultures grâce à leurs expériences et à leurs recettes. Dynamique et pétillante, l'émission "Curieux Bégin" explore de nombreux thèmes dans un univers festif.

programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. Christian Bégin nous entraîne dans de délicieuses aventures épicuriennes. Ses invités nous font découvrir plusieurs cultures grâce à leurs expériences et à leurs recettes. Dynamique et pétillante, l'émission "Curieux Bégin" explore de nombreux thèmes dans un univers festif.
